protocol.predicted_sequence_common_heavy: Exact native/baseline/JEPA heavy-atom intersection after each decoder chooses its amino-acid sequence.
protocol.all_residue_backbone: N, CA, C and O for every residue; this remains defined when the predicted amino-acid identity is wrong.
protocol.true_sequence_heavy: All native heavy atoms with true amino-acid identities supplied only for atom selection; coordinates remain decoder predictions.
protocol.true_sequence_non_ca: All native heavy atoms except C-alpha, with true amino-acid identities supplied only for atom selection; coordinates remain decoder predictions.
protocol.warning: Both decoders receive native C-alpha coordinates, so C-alpha TM-score measures anchor preservation, not fold generation.
